sections.Profile:
"Granada," released by Williams in 1972, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine with mechanical score reels.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1972–1974
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Travel, Women, Dancing, 1970s, Music
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Norm Clark
- Art: John Craig
